answer: No, he doesn't need a notary. Form NW-POA-2 replaced the notarized NW-POA-1 on February 1, 2026, and it can be signed electronically with no notary; only Georgia still requires notarization. An older NW-POA-1 was accepted only until June 30, 2026, so it won't work now. You'll still need to bring your own photo ID and the car's documents.

facts.fact: no notary is needed in Virginia (only Georgia requires one)
he can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2 electronically
